use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Image {
    pub head: Head,
    pub rows: Vec<Row>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Head {
    pub cell: Cell,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Cell {
    pub leaf: Leaf,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Leaf {
    pub n: u8,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct Row {
    pub name: String,
}
